long_biography.plain_text:
Barner’s public business record begins with vehicle refurbishment before shifting decisively into housing. From the early 2000s, Florida filings placed him across The Homestore of Ocala, Worldwide Development, Ocala and Citrus Housing Super Centers, Advanced Landholdings, Advanced Homebuilders and Advanced Mortgage Lending. Together, they show an integrated model spanning home sales, building, land and finance.

By 2016, Barner was a managing member of Worldwide Alliance. The company remains active, operates as Unified Home Builders and continues to appear in residential land-use records, with Barner still registered as a manager. Alongside that work, he co-founded Global Pictures Media and served as an executive producer on films including LBJ and The War with Grandpa.
